Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low
back pain and stiffness. The reported mechanism of the collision is consistent with
the type and force of the soft tissue injury described. Over the course of 17 visits,
care included manual therapy, guided stretching, and a graduated home exercise
program. The treatment course followed a typical progression, with visit frequency
decreasing as symptoms improved. Nearly all reported findings are based on the
patient's own descriptions of pain and limited motion. Lumbar imaging and orthopedic
examination tests were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving
the same area of the back is known to this office. Two similar billing entries for the
same date of service are currently under routine review. Prognosis is good, with
anticipated full recovery and discharge from active care once the home program is
maintained.
